label.purpose: Uppercase tracked eyebrows on panels, column heads, provenance lines.

micro.purpose: Beads, chips, timestamps — bolder as it gets smaller.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Cards and small chips at rest (--shl).

shadows.name: loom
shadows.purpose: Modals and the highest summoned surfaces (--shx).

motion.name: ease-quick
motion.purpose: Background and position shifts on controls.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Border, transform, opacity and stroke transitions; nothing slower than 200ms except the live mark.

layering.note: Hover outranks chrome; panels stay below chrome; only -1/0/auto literals allowed; enforced by style-system.test.ts.

components.name: Button
components.description: The quiet pill button; hover shifts the border to copper.
components.css: .ds-btn { padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(20, 24, 36, 0.11); border-radius: 999px; background: #ffffff; color: #141824; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: #b36a33; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b36a33; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Emphasis is copper border + copper 600-weight text — never a solid fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid #b36a33; border-radius: 999px; background: #ffffff; color: #b36a33; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b36a33; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Health wash + matching ink; the only status voice on a surface.
components.html: Healthy Degraded Unhealthy Unknown
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; margin-right: 6px; } .ds-pill-healthy { background: #e4f2eb; color: #3e8a6b; } .ds-pill-degraded { background: #f7efdb; color: #8a6a18; } .ds-pill-unhealthy { background: #fae7e1; color: #b8543a; } .ds-pill-unknown { background: #eceef3; color: #6d7188; }

narrative.overview: Nexus is a light, pastel operations canvas with its own visual identity: warm paper grounds, bubbly rounded white cards, soft pastel clusters, and animated routing marks. It deliberately does not inherit the host dashboard's dark chrome — it owns the whole viewport and retints everything from one token block. Color carries exactly two meanings and never mixes them: pastel hue encodes kind, muted at rest and saturated only on hover or open; the five health colors are the only status voice on any screen. Density is high and confident but the composition is centred, padded, and pill-shaped, so it reads friendly rather than cramped. A full dark theme exists as a token-for-token override.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper + white card surfaces; the accent is a single copper (#b36a33) used sparingly
Pastel hue = kind; ink/wash pairs = health; those are the only two color languages
Dense small type (Figtree names/headings, Nunito Sans body), heavy weights (600–700)
Pill-first form language; soft ambient shadows; no hard edges, no gloss, no gradients
One ordered layering scale, one centred content measure, one scrollbar treatment

rules.name: The Kind-Is-Hue Rule
rules.body: Pastel hue means kind and nothing else; health keeps the only status colors. A component may not use a kind pastel to signal state or a health color to decorate.

rules.name: The Paper Knockout Rule
rules.body: --paper must match the board background exactly — every bead and badge halo knocks out against it, and any drift reads as a rendering fault.

rules.name: The Muted-Until-Summoned Rule
rules.body: Kind and capability hues sit at low alpha at rest and reach full strength only on hover, selection, or an open detail.

rules.name: The Two-Faces Rule
rules.body: Figtree names things; Nunito Sans explains things. No third face, no system display font, no monospace ramp.

rules.name: The Heavy-Small Rule
rules.body: As type gets smaller it gets bolder and more tracked — never lighter. 700 at 10.5px is normal; 400 below 11px is not.

rules.name: The One-Scale Rule
rules.body: A component never picks its own z-index; it names a layer. That is how badges once ended up above status popovers, and the test now forbids it.

dos: Do take every color, radius, shadow, and z-index from the .nx-root token block; the dark theme only works because rules never hardcode palette values.
Do pair every status ink with its wash (--ok/--oksf etc.) and keep the five health pairs as the only status colors on screen.
Do centre page content with a --nx-measure* width + margin-inline: auto, and give every interactive element the 2px copper focus-visible outline.
Do keep motion quick and quiet: 120–200ms eases on borders, opacity, and transforms; the only sustained animation is the live Hermes mark and health pulses.
Do render truth: an object with absent sources reads unknown (grey), never green.
donts: Don't use a kind pastel for state or a health color for decoration — the two color languages never mix.
Don't give the mark (or anything else) gloss, gradients, or photographic shading; the world is flat ink, wash, and contour line.
Don't pick a literal z-index (beyond -1/0/auto) or restate a per-view content width; the layering scale and the measure tokens are the only sources.
Don't put vendor names on a primary surface; they belong inside the detail slide-over's evidence panel.
Don't fill buttons solid or introduce sharp corners; emphasis is a copper border and heavier text on a pill.
